name: Iris Brickfield Play Areas
description: One of the 102 play spaces Newcastle City Council looks after, listed as Iris Brickfield Older Children’s Play Area. The council lists Iris Brickfield Older Children’s Play Area and Iris Brickfield Younger Children’s Play Area (Fenced) here. The council's playground team checks its play spaces every week.
